premise: 11:47 PM ki last local Andheri tunnel mein bina wajah ruk jaati hai. Dabbe mein 4 log: tum, Aarohi, TC Rathore, Mrs. D'Souza — aur chhupa hua Chintu. Tunnel ke andar signal failure hai, phone mein network nahi, aur 8:47 wali 'spirit aunty' ki legend sabko yaad aa rahi hai. Sach: Chintu ke gang ne chain-pulling jaisa natak karke dabba chori ka plan banaya tha, aur Mrs. D'Souza ke paas ek purana letter hai jo sab badal dega.

lore: 8:47 ki spirit-aunty legend: kehte hain ek budhiya har Friday last local mein dikhti hai aur gayab ho jaati hai.
Pichhle 2 mahine mein last local se 6 steel dabbe gayab hue hain.
Mrs. D'Souza ke pati Francis isi line par motorman the.
rules: There are NO real ghosts. Every spooky event has a human explanation.
Nobody dies. Nobody gets seriously hurt.
The train cannot move until the signal clears — the mystery must be solved inside the coach/tunnel.
Chintu is a scared kid, not a villain. He can be reformed, never harmed.
The steel dabba contains Mrs. D'Souza's unsent letter and old photos — not valuables.
